ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $A$ is on the line segment $DE$, $AB\perp AC$ with the foot of the perpendicular at $A$, and $AB = AC$, $BD\perp DE$, $CE\perp DE$ with the perpendicular feet at $D$ and $E$ respectively. If $ED = 12$ and $BD = 8$, what is the length of $CE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $BD\perp DE$ and $CE\perp DE$,\\
it follows that $\angle D=\angle E=90^\circ$ and $\angle ABD+\angle BAD=90^\circ$,\\
since $AB\perp AC$,\\
it also follows that $\angle BAD+\angle EAC=90^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle ABD=\angle EAC$,\\
in $\triangle ABD$ and $\triangle CAE$, we have $\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle D=\angle E \\
AB=CA \\
\angle ABD=\angle EAC
\end{array}\right.$,\\
thus, $\triangle ABD \cong \triangle CAE$ by ASA,\\
resulting in $BD=AE=8$, and $AD=CE$,\\
therefore, $AD=ED-AE=12-8=4$,\\
hence, $CE=\boxed{4}$.

it follows that $\angle D=\angle E=90^\circ$ and $\angle ABD+\angle BAD=90^\circ$,\\
since $AB\perp AC$,\\
it also follows that $\angle BAD+\angle EAC=90^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle ABD=\angle EAC$,\\
in $\triangle ABD$ and $\triangle CAE$, we have $\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle D=\angle E \\
AB=CA \\
\angle ABD=\angle EAC
\end{array}\right.$,\\
thus, $\triangle ABD \cong \triangle CAE$ by ASA,\\
resulting in $BD=AE=8$, and $AD=CE$,\\
therefore, $AD=ED-AE=12-8=4$,\\
hence, $CE=\boxed{4}$

Image description: In the figure, D, A, E are on the same horizontal line segment DE, in the order D-A-E; BD is vertical upward at point D and perpendicular to DE, CE is vertical upward at point E and perpendicular to DE; AB connects from B obliquely downward to A, AC connects from A obliquely upward to C, and there is a right-angle mark at A, indicating AB ⟂ AC.

Reasoning: Because BD ⟂ DE and CE ⟂ DE, in △ABD, ∠D = 90°, and in △CAE, ∠E = 90°. In right triangle △ABD, ∠ABD + ∠BAD = 90°. Also because AB ⟂ AC, and AD and AE are on the same straight line, ∠BAD + ∠EAC = 90°, therefore ∠ABD = ∠EAC. It is known that AB = AC, so in △ABD and △CAE, there are ∠D = ∠E, AB = AC, ∠ABD = ∠EAC, therefore △ABD ≅ △CAE. Corresponding sides are equal, giving AE = BD = 8, CE = AD. Also ED = AD + AE = 12, so AD = 12 - 8 = 4. Therefore CE = 4.
